[PROGRAM 1]

SIGNALS OBSERVED: Score-weighted, underused top-40% parents; usually four quality/contrast, branch-diverse contexts. Best stayed 0.9297 for 31 iterations.

WHAT SEEMED TO HELP (ONLY LIST WHAT HELPED): Unlabeled mixed-score contexts produced many parent gains, including 0.9278→0.9297.

POTENTIAL KEY INSIGHT: DIVERGE 2 (0.8618,0.8870); REFINE 2 (0.9217,0.9099). Both were under-utilized during long stagnation—a missed opportunity; labeled context was empty.

[PROGRAM 2]

SIGNALS OBSERVED: High-quality/underused parents; unlabeled contexts spanned tiers and lineages, while labels used empty context. Best remained 0.9301 through 71 stagnant iterations.

WHAT SEEMED TO HELP (ONLY LIST WHAT HELPED): Unlabeled mixed contexts repeatedly produced 0.9301 from 0.9282–0.9297 parents.

POTENTIAL KEY INSIGHT: DIVERGE 9 (0.8618,0.8870,0.7943,0.8910,0.8832,0.8985,0.8907,0.8883,0.8767); REFINE 12 (0.9217,0.9099,0.9297,0.9244,0.9139,0.9215,0.8933,0.8954,0.9096,0.9129,0.9164,0.9163). Reusing parent 8b6d59ad for DIVERGE yielded 0.8832/0.8985; no label reached best.
